claim_verdicts.evidence: compose_up.md: "Builds, (re)creates, starts, and attaches to containers for a service." production.md, section "Running Compose on a single server": "You can use Compose to deploy an app to a remote Docker host by setting the DOCKER_HOST ... environment variables". features-uses.md: "Compose supports production deployments on single hosts." One engine per run, chosen by the CLI's host setting.

services.md restart: "no: The default restart policy." start-containers-automatically.md:33 always: "Always restart the container if it stops. If it's manually stopped, it's restarted only when Docker daemon restarts". R2 text now limits the reboot case to "once the engine runs" and drops on-failure; a restart policy is an engine setting with no cross-host behaviour. Lesson §4 wording matches.

Ran: git -C examples/don-hang show stage-1:docker-compose.yml | grep -c "restart:" -> 0. Working tree (stage-2 content) also prints 0. Default policy is no per services.md ("It does not restart the container under any circumstances"), so the containers stay stopped after a reboot until scripts/up.sh (docker compose up -d --build --wait) runs again.
services.md, ### container_name: "Compose does not scale a service beyond one container if the Compose file specifies a container_name. Attempting to do so results in an error."

Ran: git show stage-1:docker-compose.yml | grep -n "container_name:" -> 11 donhang-lab, 46 donhang-web, 58 donhang-db, 87 donhang-api, 106 donhang-app-web (5 lines, 5 services). grep -c "restart:" -> 0. Lines 81-99: ipv4_address: 172.28.0.13 at line 99; no deploy/placement key anywhere in the file. Code block in §5 matches lines 81-99 verbatim.

bridge.md: "Bridge networks apply to containers running on the same Docker daemon host. For communication among containers running on different Docker daemon hosts, you ..." (overlay). The donhang network at stage-1 declares no driver, so it is the default bridge driver.

features-uses.md:58 "Compose supports production deployments on single hosts." compose_up.md: "Builds, (re)creates, starts, and attaches to containers for a service." on the one engine the CLI addresses. stage-1 docker-compose.yml has no deploy/placement key (grep). R2 text scoped to Đơn Hàng's file and to docker compose up, no longer says Compose has no machine field.

"You can describe the desired state for your deployed containers using Kubernetes, and it can change the actual state to the desired state". Self-healing: "Kubernetes restarts containers that fail, replaces containers, kills containers that don't respond to your user-defined health check".

nodes.md: node controller is responsible for "In the case that a node becomes unreachable, updating the Ready condition ... to Unknown" and "If a node remains unreachable: triggering API-initiated eviction for all of the Pods on the unreachable node. By default, the node controller waits 5 minutes ...". Overview self-healing: "replaces containers". Lesson gives no timing, so the 5-minute default does not contradict it.

But images built or pulled by Docker would not be visible to container runtime and Kubernetes. They needed to be pushed to some registry to allow them to be used by Kubernetes." images.md: "You typically create a container image of your application and push it to a registry before referring to it in a Pod."
